summary: Tested backend (voice list/select/speak, chat, lilith image gen) via pytest and frontend flows (age gate, chat send, voice preview toggle, wardrobe outfit -> image render) via Playwright. All 5 backend tests passed (23s). Frontend voice preview correctly toggles ▶ -> ■ -> ▶, fires request to storage.googleapis.com/eleven-public-prod/... Wardrobe 'Black lace lingerie on silk bed' generated a Lilith image via Pollinations/Flux and rendered in avatar-side.

issues: Console warning: 'MediaElementAudioSource outputs zeroes due to CORS access restrictions' when analysing the ElevenLabs preview URL. Audio itself still plays and the ▶/■ state transition works, but the audio analyser (used for mouth/wave visualisation) cannot read the remote preview stream. Consider proxying the preview through the backend, or skipping _startAudioAnalysis() specifically for cross-origin preview URLs to silence the warning.

action_items: (Optional) Suppress or fix the MediaElementAudioSource CORS warning during voice preview playback by either bypassing the WebAudio analyser for cross-origin preview URLs or proxying preview_url through the backend.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is ~486 lines and mixes many concerns (voice, chat, image, gallery, reference, pose). Consider splitting into APIRouter modules per concern (voice_router.py, image_router.py, chat_router.py) — file is approaching the 700-line soft limit.
/api/voice/list performs a MongoDB read + write on every call to persist the current voice; consider caching in memory or only writing on /select.

previewVoice() in App.jsx sets el.onended and el.onpause to the same handler, which will resolve() twice if the audio both ends and pauses; the guard nulls handlers on first fire so it's safe, but a single 'ended' listener via addEventListener with { once: true } would be cleaner.
test_credentials: None required (no auth on app; age gate bypassed via localStorage 'lilith:18ok'='yes').
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend regression suite at /app/backend/tests/backend_test.py covers voice list/select/speak, chat, and lilith image gen. Image gen uses Pollinations/Flux fallback (~20-30s). Voice preview URLs come from ElevenLabs public GCS bucket; playback works but WebAudio analyser hits CORS (non-blocking warning). Frontend uses Vite HMR — during long tests a server reload can wipe React state; if that happens, reload the page rather than assuming a bug.
rca of the issue: N/A — no functional regressions found. The only surfaced issue (CORS warning on voice preview audio analysis) is cosmetic; audio still plays and UI state transitions correctly.
